---
title: "07 - Robustness analyses (Tables S11-S14, Figure S5)"
format: html
---

Secondary analyses testing whether (a) the overall null and (b) the exploratory cardioembolic (CES) estimate depend on single
loci, the SNP set, the estimator or atrial fibrillation (AF) pathways. The primary estimator stays random-effects IVW
(`02`, `03`, `04`). Inputs: `mr_*.rds` from `02`-`04`; two raw GWAS Catalog files for the new data (MEGASTROKE cardioembolic
GCST006910, 0.34 GB; AF GCST006414, 1.3 GB), downloaded by `get_raw()` and cached as small `.rds` files.

```{r setup}
source("00_setup.R")
exp_dat <- readRDS(need_file(file.path(DIR$proc, "exp_dat.rds"), "run 01_extract_exposure.qmd stage A"))
bat  <- load_batteries()
outs <- lapply(bat, function(b) b$dat)                              # retained SNPs with Steiger flags
cat("Smallest outcome P among instruments, all outcomes:", signif(min(sapply(outs, function(d) min(d$pval.outcome))), 3), "\n")
```

## 1. Loci

```{r loci}
loci <- define_loci(exp_dat)
HP_locus  <- loci$locus[loci$SNP == LOCUS_ANCHORS$HP]               # haptoglobin region
LPA_locus <- loci$locus[loci$SNP == LOCUS_ANCHORS$LPA]              # lipoprotein(a) region
MHC_locus <- unique(loci$locus[loci$SNP %in% LOCUS_ANCHORS$MHC])    # major histocompatibility complex
stopifnot(length(HP_locus) == 1, length(LPA_locus) == 1, length(MHC_locus) >= 1)
cat("Loci:", n_distinct(loci$locus), "| multi-SNP loci:\n")
print(loci %>% filter(n_snps > 1) %>% distinct(locus, locus_label, n_snps))
snps_in <- function(L) loci$SNP[loci$locus %in% L]
```

## 2. Alternative SNP sets (IVW and weighted median)

```{r subsets}
common <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(outs, function(d) d$SNP))
cat("SNPs retained in all five outcomes:", length(common), "\n")
est <- function(d, key, set) {
  if (nrow(d) < 3) return(NULL)
  set.seed(SEED); m <- suppressMessages(mr(d, method_list = c("mr_ivw", "mr_weighted_median")))
  data.frame(outcome = key, set = set, method = ifelse(m$method == M[["ivw"]], "IVW", "WM"), nsnp = nrow(d),
             beta = m$b, se = m$se, OR = exp(m$b), lci = exp(m$b - 1.96 * m$se), uci = exp(m$b + 1.96 * m$se), pval = m$pval)
}
subsets_of <- function(d) {
  s <- list(primary = d, hp = d[!d$SNP %in% snps_in(HP_locus), ], lpa = d[!d$SNP %in% snps_in(LPA_locus), ],
            hlm = d[!d$SNP %in% snps_in(c(HP_locus, LPA_locus, MHC_locus)), ],
            steiger = d[is.na(d$steiger_dir) | d$steiger_dir, ], common = d[d$SNP %in% common, ])
  setNames(s, unname(SET_LABELS[names(s)]))
}
wide <- function(df) df %>% filter(method == "IVW") %>% mutate(txt = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f) p=%.3g n=%d", OR, lci, uci, pval, nsnp)) %>%
  select(outcome, set, txt) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = txt) %>% as.data.frame()
rob <- bind_rows(lapply(KEYS, function(k) { ss <- subsets_of(outs[[k]]); bind_rows(lapply(names(ss), function(s) est(ss[[s]], k, s))) }))
print(wide(rob), right = FALSE)
```

## 3. Leave-one-locus-out

```{r llo}
llo <- bind_rows(lapply(KEYS, function(k) {
  d <- outs[[k]]; dl <- merge(d[, "SNP", drop = FALSE], loci[, c("SNP", "locus", "locus_label")], by = "SNP")
  bind_rows(lapply(unique(dl$locus), function(L) {
    dd <- d[!d$SNP %in% dl$SNP[dl$locus == L], ]
    set.seed(SEED); m <- suppressMessages(mr(dd, method_list = "mr_ivw"))
    data.frame(outcome_label = k, locus = L, locus_label = unique(dl$locus_label[dl$locus == L]), n_removed = nrow(d) - nrow(dd),
               nsnp = nrow(dd), beta = m$b, se = m$se, OR = exp(m$b), lci = exp(m$b - 1.96 * m$se), uci = exp(m$b + 1.96 * m$se), pval = m$pval)
  }))
}))
S12 <- llo %>% group_by(Outcome = outcome_label) %>%
  summarise(N_loci = n(), IVW_OR_min = min(OR), IVW_OR_max = max(OR), P_min = min(pval), P_max = max(pval),
            `N_loci_with_P_lt_0.05` = sum(pval < 0.05), Least_favourable_locus = locus_label[which.max(pval)])
print(as.data.frame(S12), digits = 4)
```

## 4. MR-RAPS (robust to outliers and balanced pleiotropy)

```{r raps}
raps_fit <- function(d) suppressMessages(mr_raps(d$beta.exposure, d$beta.outcome, d$se.exposure, d$se.outcome,
                                                 parameters = list(over.dispersion = TRUE, loss.function = "tukey", shrinkage = FALSE)))
raps <- bind_rows(lapply(KEYS, function(k) {
  d <- outs[[k]]; set.seed(SEED); r <- raps_fit(d)
  data.frame(outcome = k, set = SET_LABELS[["primary"]], method = "MR-RAPS", nsnp = nrow(d), beta = r$b, se = r$se,
             OR = exp(r$b), lci = exp(r$b - 1.96 * r$se), uci = exp(r$b + 1.96 * r$se), pval = r$pval)
}))
print(raps, digits = 4)
```

## 5. Consistency check in the earlier MEGASTROKE cardioembolic GWAS (GCST006910)

A consistency check, not independent replication: the MEGASTROKE studies are part of GIGASTROKE, so case sets overlap, and
GIGASTROKE added further cohorts including UK Biobank.

```{r mega_ces}
f_mc <- file.path(DIR$proc, "dat_megaces_harmonised.rds")
if (!file.exists(f_mc)) {
  mc  <- fread(get_raw("MEGA_CES"), select = c("hm_rsid", "hm_chrom", "hm_pos", "hm_other_allele", "hm_effect_allele",
                                               "hm_beta", "hm_effect_allele_frequency", "standard_error", "p_value"))
  mc2 <- as.data.frame(mc[hm_rsid %in% exp_dat$SNP]); rm(mc); invisible(gc()); mc2 <- mc2[!duplicated(mc2$hm_rsid), ]
  cat("Instruments matched by rsID in GCST006910:", nrow(mc2), "of", nrow(exp_dat), "\n")
  o <- format_data(mc2, type = "outcome", snp_col = "hm_rsid", beta_col = "hm_beta", se_col = "standard_error",
                   eaf_col = "hm_effect_allele_frequency", effect_allele_col = "hm_effect_allele",
                   other_allele_col = "hm_other_allele", pval_col = "p_value", chr_col = "hm_chrom", pos_col = "hm_pos")
  o$outcome <- outcome_short("MEGA_CES"); o$id.outcome <- "GCST006910"
  saveRDS(harmonise_data(exp_dat, o, action = 2), f_mc)
}
b_mc <- run_battery(readRDS(f_mc), "MEGA_CES"); print_battery(b_mc)
b_mc$res[, c("method", "nsnp", "b", "se", "pval")]
outs$MEGA_CES <- b_mc$dat
```

## 6. Atrial fibrillation (AF)

AF is the dominant cardioembolic source, so a CES-specific association could run through AF. AF GWAS: Nielsen et al. 2018
(GCST006414; 60,620 cases / 970,216 controls; European; includes UK Biobank). Steps: (i) AF instruments = genome-wide
significant SNPs, one lead SNP per 1-Mb window by positional pruning (no LD reference); (ii) positive control, AF to stroke
subtypes; (iii) GlycA to AF; (iv) CES with AF-related instruments removed; (v) exploratory product-of-coefficients estimate.
The joint GlycA + AF multivariable MR needs the OpenGWAS token (`11_reverse_and_af_mvmr_token.qmd`).

```{r af_cache}
f_ai <- file.path(DIR$proc, "af_instruments.rds"); f_ag <- file.path(DIR$proc, "af_glyca_snps.rds")
if (!file.exists(f_ai) || !file.exists(f_ag)) {
  af <- fread(get_raw("AF"), select = c("hm_rsid", "hm_chrom", "hm_pos", "hm_other_allele", "hm_effect_allele", "hm_beta",
                                        "hm_effect_allele_frequency", "standard_error", "p_value"))
  af[, p_value := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p_value))]            # read as character in this file
  af <- af[!is.na(hm_beta) & !is.na(standard_error) & !is.na(p_value)]
  saveRDS(af[hm_rsid %in% exp_dat$SNP], f_ag)
  a <- af[p_value < 5e-8 & grepl("^rs", hm_rsid)]; rm(af); invisible(gc())
  a[, chr := as.integer(hm_chrom)]; a <- a[!is.na(chr)]; a[, z2 := (hm_beta / standard_error)^2]; setorder(a, -z2)
  cat("Genome-wide significant AF SNPs before pruning:", nrow(a), "\n")
  removed <- rep(FALSE, nrow(a)); lead <- integer(0)                # greedy: strongest SNP first, drop neighbours within 500 kb
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(a))) {
    if (removed[i]) next
    lead <- c(lead, i); removed <- removed | (a$chr == a$chr[i] & abs(a$hm_pos - a$hm_pos[i]) <= 500000)
  }
  ai <- a[lead][!duplicated(hm_rsid)]; ai[, F := z2]; saveRDS(ai, f_ai)
}
af_iv  <- readRDS(f_ai)
stopifnot(is.numeric(af_iv$p_value), all(af_iv$p_value < 5e-8), !anyDuplicated(af_iv$hm_rsid))   # a stale or mis-filtered cache stops here
af_gly <- as.data.frame(readRDS(f_ag)); af_gly <- af_gly[!duplicated(af_gly$hm_rsid), ]
cat("AF lead SNPs (500-kb positional pruning):", nrow(af_iv), "| median F:", round(median(af_iv$F), 1), "\n")

af_exp <- format_data(as.data.frame(af_iv), type = "exposure", snp_col = "hm_rsid", beta_col = "hm_beta", se_col = "standard_error",
                      eaf_col = "hm_effect_allele_frequency", effect_allele_col = "hm_effect_allele", other_allele_col = "hm_other_allele",
                      pval_col = "p_value", chr_col = "chr", pos_col = "hm_pos")
af_exp$exposure <- "Atrial fibrillation (Nielsen 2018)"
af_exp$samplesize.exposure <- 60620L + 970216L
```

```{r af_to_stroke}
rd <- function(k) fread(get_raw(k), select = c("chromosome", "base_pair_location", "effect_allele", "other_allele", "beta",
                                                "standard_error", "effect_allele_frequency", "p_value", "rsid"))
getout <- function(dt, ids, name) {
  d <- as.data.frame(dt[rsid %in% ids]); d <- d[!duplicated(d$rsid), ]
  o <- format_data(d, type = "outcome", snp_col = "rsid", beta_col = "beta", se_col = "standard_error", eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency",
                   effect_allele_col = "effect_allele", other_allele_col = "other_allele", pval_col = "p_value")
  o$outcome <- name; o
}
af_out <- list(CES = getout(rd("CES"), af_exp$SNP, "CES"), LAS = getout(rd("LAS"), af_exp$SNP, "LAS"), SVS = getout(rd("SVS"), af_exp$SNP, "SVS"))
mcf <- fread(get_raw("MEGA_CES"), select = c("hm_rsid", "hm_other_allele", "hm_effect_allele", "hm_beta", "hm_effect_allele_frequency", "standard_error", "p_value"))
mcd <- as.data.frame(mcf[hm_rsid %in% af_exp$SNP]); mcd <- mcd[!duplicated(mcd$hm_rsid), ]; rm(mcf)
af_out$MEGA_CES <- format_data(mcd, type = "outcome", snp_col = "hm_rsid", beta_col = "hm_beta", se_col = "standard_error",
                               eaf_col = "hm_effect_allele_frequency", effect_allele_col = "hm_effect_allele",
                               other_allele_col = "hm_other_allele", pval_col = "p_value")
af_out$MEGA_CES$outcome <- "MEGA_CES"
afm <- bind_rows(lapply(names(af_out), function(k) {
  d <- suppressMessages(harmonise_data(af_exp, af_out[[k]], action = 2)); d <- d[d$mr_keep, ]
  set.seed(SEED); m <- suppressMessages(mr(d)); h <- mr_heterogeneity(d); pl <- mr_pleiotropy_test(d)
  m$outcome_label <- k; m$Qp <- pick_method(h, "ivw")$Q_pval; m$egger_int_p <- pl$pval; m
}))
afm$OR <- exp(afm$b); afm$lci <- exp(afm$b - 1.96 * afm$se); afm$uci <- exp(afm$b + 1.96 * afm$se)
print(afm[afm$method == M[["ivw"]], c("outcome_label", "nsnp", "OR", "lci", "uci", "pval")], digits = 4)
```

```{r glyca_to_af}
af_o <- format_data(af_gly, type = "outcome", snp_col = "hm_rsid", beta_col = "hm_beta", se_col = "standard_error", eaf_col = "hm_effect_allele_frequency",
                    effect_allele_col = "hm_effect_allele", other_allele_col = "hm_other_allele", pval_col = "p_value", chr_col = "hm_chrom", pos_col = "hm_pos")
af_o$outcome <- "Atrial fibrillation"
dga <- suppressMessages(harmonise_data(exp_dat, af_o, action = 2)); dga <- dga[dga$mr_keep, ]
cat("GlycA instruments usable for AF:", nrow(dga), "of", nrow(exp_dat), "\n")
set.seed(SEED); mga <- suppressMessages(mr(dga)); hga <- mr_heterogeneity(dga); pga <- mr_pleiotropy_test(dga)
set.seed(SEED); rp <- raps_fit(dga)
mga$OR <- exp(mga$b); mga$lci <- exp(mga$b - 1.96 * mga$se); mga$uci <- exp(mga$b + 1.96 * mga$se)
print(mga[, c("method", "nsnp", "b", "se", "OR", "lci", "uci", "pval")], digits = 4)
afp <- setNames(dga$pval.outcome, dga$SNP)                          # AF p-value of each GlycA instrument
```

```{r af_exclusion}
afloc <- as.data.frame(af_iv)[, c("chr", "hm_pos")]
exp_dat$near_AF <- mapply(function(chr, pos) any(afloc$chr == as.integer(chr) & abs(afloc$hm_pos - as.numeric(pos)) <= 5e5),
                          exp_dat$chr.exposure, exp_dat$pos.exposure)
cat("GlycA instruments within 500 kb of an AF lead SNP:", paste(exp_dat$SNP[exp_dat$near_AF], collapse = ", "), "\n")
afsens <- bind_rows(lapply(c("CES", "MEGA_CES", "MEGASTROKE", "GIGASTROKE"), function(k) {
  d <- outs[[k]]; lowp <- names(afp)[afp < 1e-3]; near <- exp_dat$SNP[exp_dat$near_AF]
  sets <- setNames(list(d, d[!d$SNP %in% lowp, ], d[!d$SNP %in% near, ], d[!d$SNP %in% lowp & !d$SNP %in% near, ]),
                   c("Primary", unname(SET_LABELS[c("af_p", "af_near", "af_both")])))
  bind_rows(lapply(names(sets), function(s) est(sets[[s]], k, s)))
}))
print(wide(afsens), right = FALSE)

# exploratory product of coefficients (delta-method SE); assumes no GlycA x AF interaction and valid AF instruments
ba <- pick_method(mga, "ivw")$b; sa <- pick_method(mga, "ivw")$se
cesx <- afm[afm$outcome_label == "CES" & afm$method == M[["ivw"]], ]; bb <- cesx$b; sb <- cesx$se
tot <- pick_method(bat$CES$res, "ivw")$b
ind <- ba * bb; se_ind <- sqrt(bb^2 * sa^2 + ba^2 * sb^2)
med <- data.frame(total_logOR = tot, a_GlycA_to_AF = ba, a_se = sa, b_AF_to_CES = bb, b_se = sb, indirect = ind, indirect_se = se_ind,
                  indirect_lci = ind - 1.96 * se_ind, indirect_uci = ind + 1.96 * se_ind, indirect_OR = exp(ind),
                  prop_mediated = ind / tot, direct_logOR = tot - ind)
print(t(med), digits = 4)
```

## 7. Tables S11-S14

```{r tables}
tidy_tab <- function(df) df %>% mutate(Outcome = outcome_short(outcome), OR_CI = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", OR, lci, uci), P = signif(pval, 3)) %>%
  select(Outcome, Analysis_set = set, Method = method, N_SNPs = nsnp, beta, se, OR, CI_lower = lci, CI_upper = uci, OR_CI, P)
S11 <- bind_rows(tidy_tab(rob), tidy_tab(afsens %>% filter(set != "Primary")), tidy_tab(raps))
S11 <- S11[!duplicated(S11[, c("Outcome", "Analysis_set", "Method")]), ]
S11 <- S11 %>% arrange(factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_short(c("MEGASTROKE", "GIGASTROKE", "CES", "MEGA_CES", "LAS", "SVS"))), Analysis_set, Method)
write.csv(S11, file.path(DIR$tab, "TableS11_robustness_analysis_sets.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(S12, file.path(DIR$tab, "TableS12_leave_one_locus_out_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(loci %>% arrange(locus) %>% select(Locus_ID = locus, Locus = locus_label, N_instruments = n_snps, SNP, chr = chr.exposure, pos_hg19 = pos.exposure, F),
          file.path(DIR$tab, "TableS12b_locus_definitions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(llo, file.path(DIR$tab, "TableS12c_leave_one_locus_out_full.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

r4 <- function(df) df %>% mutate(across(any_of(c("beta", "se", "OR", "CI_lower", "CI_upper")), ~ round(.x, 4)))
full_label <- function(key, name) { m <- outcome_meta(key)
  sprintf("%s (%s; %s cases / %s controls)", name, m$id, format(m$ncase, big.mark = ","), format(m$ncontrol, big.mark = ",")) }
S13_lab <- c(full_label("CES", "GIGASTROKE CES"), full_label("MEGA_CES", "MEGASTROKE CES"))
q_note  <- function(b) sprintf("Q P=%.3f; Egger intercept P=%.3f", pick_method(b$het, "ivw")$Q_pval, b$pleio$pval)
S13 <- r4(bind_rows(
  bind_rows(bat$CES$res %>% mutate(Outcome = S13_lab[1]), b_mc$res %>% mutate(Outcome = S13_lab[2])) %>%
    transmute(Outcome, Method = method, N_SNPs = nsnp, beta = b, se, OR = exp(b), CI_lower = exp(b - 1.96 * se), CI_upper = exp(b + 1.96 * se),
              P = signif(pval, 3), Note = NA_character_),
  data.frame(Outcome = S13_lab, Method = "Cochran Q (IVW) / Egger intercept P", N_SNPs = c(nrow(bat$CES$dat), nrow(b_mc$dat)),
             Note = c(q_note(bat$CES), q_note(b_mc)))))
write.csv(S13, file.path(DIR$tab, "TableS13_MEGASTROKE_CES_consistency.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

af_methods <- unname(M[c("ivw", "wm", "egger", "simple", "wmode")])
S14a <- afm %>% filter(method %in% af_methods) %>%
  transmute(Analysis = "AF -> stroke outcome (positive control)",
            Exposure = paste0("Atrial fibrillation (Nielsen 2018; ", nrow(af_iv), " positionally pruned lead SNPs)"),
            Outcome = outcome_label, Method = method, N_SNPs = nsnp, beta = b, se, OR, CI_lower = lci, CI_upper = uci,
            P = signif(pval, 3), Q_P = signif(Qp, 3), Egger_intercept_P = signif(egger_int_p, 3))
S14b <- mga %>% transmute(Analysis = "GlycA -> AF", Exposure = "GlycA (60 instruments)", Outcome = "Atrial fibrillation (GCST006414)", Method = method,
                          N_SNPs = nsnp, beta = b, se, OR, CI_lower = lci, CI_upper = uci, P = signif(pval, 3),
                          Q_P = signif(pick_method(hga, "ivw")$Q_pval, 3), Egger_intercept_P = signif(pga$pval, 3))
S14b <- bind_rows(S14b, data.frame(Analysis = "GlycA -> AF", Exposure = "GlycA (60 instruments)", Outcome = "Atrial fibrillation (GCST006414)",
                                   Method = "MR-RAPS", N_SNPs = nrow(dga), beta = rp$b, se = rp$se, OR = exp(rp$b),
                                   CI_lower = exp(rp$b - 1.96 * rp$se), CI_upper = exp(rp$b + 1.96 * rp$se), P = signif(rp$pval, 3)))
write.csv(r4(bind_rows(S14a, S14b)), file.path(DIR$tab, "TableS14_atrial_fibrillation_analyses.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(quantity = names(med), value = round(unlist(med[1, ]), 5)), file.path(DIR$tab, "TableS14b_AF_product_of_coefficients.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(S11 %>% filter(grepl("AF", Analysis_set)), file.path(DIR$tab, "TableS14c_CES_excluding_AF_associated_SNPs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(list(rob = rob, llo = llo, raps = raps, afsens = afsens, afm = afm, mga = mga, med = med, S11 = S11, S12 = S12, S13 = S13),
        file.path(DIR$proc, "robustness_summary.rds"))
```

## 8. Figure S5 - robustness of the cardioembolic estimate

All counts and the statements in the title and subtitle are computed from the results.

```{r figS5}
G <- outcome_short("CES"); n_ces <- nrow(bat$CES$dat)
mm   <- S13[S13$Outcome == S13_lab[2] & S13$Method == M[["ivw"]], ]
core <- bat$CES$res; core <- cbind(core, or_ci(core$b, core$se))
gv   <- function(m) core[core$method == M[[m]], ]
sel  <- function(s) S11[S11$Outcome == G & S11$Analysis_set == SET_LABELS[[s]] & S11$Method == "IVW", ][1, ]
grp_est <- sprintf("Estimator (all %d SNPs)", n_ces)
rows <- list(
  c(grp_est, "IVW, random effects (primary)", gv("ivw")$OR, gv("ivw")$OR_lci, gv("ivw")$OR_uci, n_ces),
  c(grp_est, "Weighted median", gv("wm")$OR, gv("wm")$OR_lci, gv("wm")$OR_uci, n_ces),
  c(grp_est, "MR-Egger", gv("egger")$OR, gv("egger")$OR_lci, gv("egger")$OR_uci, n_ces),
  c(grp_est, "MR-RAPS (robust to outliers)", raps$OR[raps$outcome == "CES"], raps$lci[raps$outcome == "CES"], raps$uci[raps$outcome == "CES"], n_ces))
spec <- c(hp = sprintf("Without HP locus (chr16, %d SNPs)", sum(outs$CES$SNP %in% snps_in(HP_locus))),
          lpa = sprintf("Without LPA locus (chr6, %d SNPs)", sum(outs$CES$SNP %in% snps_in(LPA_locus))),
          hlm = "Without HP, LPA and MHC loci", common = sprintf("%d SNPs shared by all five outcomes", length(common)),
          af_p = "Without SNPs with AF p < 0.001", af_near = "Without SNPs near AF lead SNPs", af_both = "Without either AF-related group")
for (s in names(spec)) {
  p <- sel(s); grp <- if (grepl("^af_", s)) "Removing AF-related instruments" else "Removing loci / restricting SNP set"
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- c(grp, spec[[s]], p$OR, p$CI_lower, p$CI_upper, p$N_SNPs)
}
rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- c("Earlier release (partly overlapping cases)", "MEGASTROKE 2018 CES, IVW", mm$OR, mm$CI_lower, mm$CI_upper, mm$N_SNPs)
fd <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, rows), stringsAsFactors = FALSE); names(fd) <- c("group", "label", "OR", "lci", "uci", "n")
fd[, c("OR", "lci", "uci", "n")] <- lapply(fd[, c("OR", "lci", "uci", "n")], as.numeric)
fd$group <- factor(fd$group, levels = unique(fd$group)); fd$label <- factor(fd$label, levels = rev(fd$label))
fd$txt <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)  n=%d", fd$OR, fd$lci, fd$uci, fd$n); fd$primary <- fd$label == "IVW, random effects (primary)"
cesl <- S12[S12$Outcome == "CES", ]
n_all <- nrow(fd); n_excl <- sum(fd$uci < 1); n_below1 <- sum(fd$OR < 1)
fig_title <- if (n_below1 == n_all) {
  sprintf("Cardioembolic estimate points the same way in all %d analyses; the 95%% CI excludes 1 in %d", n_all, n_excl)
} else {
  sprintf("Cardioembolic estimate: OR < 1 in %d of %d analyses; the 95%% CI excludes 1 in %d", n_below1, n_all, n_excl)
}
fig_sub <- sprintf("Shaded band: range of IVW estimates over %d leave-one-locus-out analyses (OR %.3f-%.3f; P %.3f-%.3f%s)",
                   cesl$N_loci, cesl$IVW_OR_min, cesl$IVW_OR_max, cesl$P_min, cesl$P_max,
                   if (cesl$`N_loci_with_P_lt_0.05` == cesl$N_loci) " in every one" else "")
figS5 <- ggplot(fd, aes(x = OR, y = label)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = cesl$IVW_OR_min, xmax = cesl$IVW_OR_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#2b6a99", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lci, xmax = uci, colour = primary), width = 0, linewidth = 0.7, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = primary, size = primary), shape = 15) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.34, label = txt), hjust = 0, size = 2.7, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1b4f72", `FALSE` = "grey45"), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 2.6, `FALSE` = 1.9), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1, 1.2)) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.68, 1.30), clip = "off") +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio for cardioembolic stroke per 1-SD higher GlycA (95% CI)", y = NULL, title = fig_title, subtitle = fig_sub) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, face = "plain", size = 8), plot.title = element_text(size = 9.5, hjust = 0, face = "plain"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey30"), plot.title.position = "plot", plot.margin = margin(6, 110, 6, 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
ggsave(file.path(DIR$fig, "FigureS5_cardioembolic_robustness.png"), figS5, width = 9.2, height = 4.6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(DIR$fig, "FigureS5_cardioembolic_robustness.pdf"), figS5, width = 9.2, height = 4.6)
```
